title: Return window and proof of purchase
text: If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you may return the merchandise within 90 days of the original purchase date with valid proof of purchase.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Uses 'may' for return right; outcome at discretion of merchant beyond stated 90-day window and proof of purchase conditions.

title: Refund method for returned merchandise
text: Merchandise returned with valid proof of purchase will receive a refund in the manner of original payment (exclusions apply) for merchandise only.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'exclusions apply' is not specified in this document.

title: No returns without proof of purchase
text: Rockler does not accept returns without valid proof of purchase.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Rewards Card reduction or void on return
text: In Rockler’s discretion, if the original transaction included promotional Rewards Cards (not Gift Cards), then the Promotional Rewards Cards will be voided if unused or the refund amount will be reduced by the amount of the Rewards Card redeemed.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Applied 'in Rockler's discretion'; outcome not fixed.

title: Full refund requires all components
text: *Merchandise being returned must include all components to receive a full refund.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Return shipping charges
text: Customer will be responsible for shipping charges unless item is damaged or defective.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Restocking fee
text: Some items may incur a restocking fee.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'Some items' does not identify which items or the fee amount.

title: Non-returnable software, plans and clearance
text: Software, downloadable plans and clearance items are non-returnable.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Promotional gift card void or deduction
text: Promotional gift cards (gift card with purchase) will be voided if unused, or the refund amount will be deducted based on the value of the gift card if redeemed.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Authorization before return
text: Rockler encourages that merchandise be approved for authorization prior to being returned.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Phrased as encouragement, not a firm requirement.

title: Authorization required for power tools and direct ship
text: Power tools and direct ship items require authorization on all returns.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Manufacturer warranty supersedes Rockler offer
text: Manufacturer’s warranty supersedes any offer from Rockler.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Online purchases returned by mail
text: Merchandise purchased online at Rockler.com may be returned by mail and must follow the Rockler return policy guidelines.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'may be returned' does not state a firm right to return by mail.

title: Customer pays restocking fee and shipping on online returns
text: Items may be subject to a restocking fee and customer is responsible for shipping.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'may be subject to' leaves fee application undetermined.

title: Third-party web order returns
text: Rockler branded merchandise purchased through third party websites (i.e. Amazon) will need to follow the third-party return guidelines.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Third-party guidelines are not set out in this document.

title: Power tool warranty, authorization and costs
text: Power tools, CNC machines and laser products are subject to the manufacturer’s warranty, which supersedes any offer from Rockler. All items require authorization before returning.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Power tool return shipping and restocking costs
text: Customer will be responsible for shipping costs and restocking fees based on the price of the merchandise being returned.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Restocking fee amount basis is not given as a number.

title: Non-warranty power tool return condition
text: Any non-warranty returns must be unused and in original packaging.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Laguna and Sawstop non-returnable
text: Laguna and Sawstop power tools are non-returnable.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Router bit guarantee
text: If a Rockler Router bit fails to perform for any reason, we will replace it. No proof of purchase required.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Drawer slide lifetime guarantee
text: If a Rockler TopSlide/Centerline Lifetime drawer slide fails to perform for any reason, we will replace it. No proof of purchase required.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Guarantee replacement name and address
text: Name and address must be included in the package to process the exchange.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Manufacturer-shipped items warranty
text: Merchandise purchased and shipped directly from the manufacturer is covered by the manufacturer’s warranty and supersede any offer from Rockler.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Manufacturer-shipped items costs
text: Customer will be responsible for shipping costs and restocking fees.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Restocking fee amount not specified.

title: Clearance items final sale
text: Clearance items are sold as final sale and are not eligible for return.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Retail store returns location
text: Items purchased at Rockler’s retail stores must be returned to a Rockler retail store location.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Store return refund method
text: Merchandise that is returned to a Rockler store location will receive a refund in the order of original payment.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Original shipping charges not refunded
text: Original shipping charges will not be refunded.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Original credit card or gift card refund
text: Customer will have to present the original credit card used to receive refund or a Rockler Gift card will be issued.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Apple Pay and PayPal refunds
text: Purchases made with either tender require third party processing and stores can only issue a Rockler gift card.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Cash or debit card returns
text: Merchandise returns made to a retail store with a receipt may require a mail order check due to limitations of cash on hand on the store.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'may require' leaves refund method undetermined.

title: Cancellation not guaranteed
text: Once your Rockler.com order is submitted we cannot guarantee your request to modify or cancel.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Cancellation explicitly not guaranteed; outcome discretionary.

title: Return after failed cancellation
text: If it is too late to cancel your order you may return any unwanted items in accordance with our returns policy.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Orders subject to approval
text: All orders are subject to approval.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: No criteria given for approval.

title: Discount codes not combinable
text: Discount codes entered at checkout cannot be combined with other offers or applied to previous orders.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Promotions while supplies last
text: Promotions are while supplies last and subject to change.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Promotion availability is discretionary.

title: Promotional gift card voided on merchandise return
text: In the event of a merchandise return, an unredeemed promotional gift card will be voided. If a promotional gift card has been redeemed the promotional gift card amount will be deducted from the final refund.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Promotional gift card validity
text: Promotional gift cards are valid only for future orders.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Rewards card expiry
text: Rewards card expire one year after activation.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Rewards card not redeemable for cash or replaced if lost
text: Rewards card is not redeemable for cash (except where required by law) and cannot be replaced if lost or stolen.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Return shipping charges borne by customer
text: Please note that you will be responsible for any return shipping charges.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Out-of-stock item back order
text: In the case of an out-of-stock, we will place the rest of your order, and put the out-of-stock item on back order.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Discontinued item notification
text: If an item you ordered has been discontinued, we will notify you and let you know if there are any recommended replacement items.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Recommended replacements are offered at discretion; no refund or cancellation right is stated.

title: Shipping and handling charge schedule
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Shipping carriers for free or economy shipping
text: When Free or Economy Shipping is selected, Rockler determines the most efficient shipping carrier for your order. The carriers that may be used are: UPS Ground, UPS Surepost (which final delivery will be made by your local post office) or USPS.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Delivery estimate contiguous US
text: If you are ordering within the contiguous United States, you can expect your order within 7 to 10 business days.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Direct ship items contiguous states only
text: Most direct ship items ship within the 48 contiguous states only.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'Most' leaves exceptions undefined.

title: Direct ship items are special orders charged at order
text: Direct ship items are considered special order. Your account will be charged when you place your order.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Transit times not guaranteed for international orders
text: Please note that all transit times are estimates only and are not guaranteed. Delivery may be delayed by customs clearance or other factors outside of UPS's and Rockler's control.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Partial order restriction for certain destinations
text: We do not ship partial orders to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, Guam, or to our international customers. In addition we do not ship partial orders to AFO and FPO addresses. All ordered items must be in stock before the order will be shipped.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Stock status delay notification
text: Occasionally an item showing in stock may go out of stock by the time your order is filled. In these cases, we will notify you of the delay as soon as possible via e-mail or phone.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Backorder expected date not guaranteed
text: The in-stock date displayed in our online catalog for out of stock items is approximate and not guaranteed.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Buy online pickup no fee
text: No, in-store pickup incurs no additional charges.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Store pickup: only account holder may pick up
text: Only the person on the account’s billing information is authorized to pick up the order.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: In-store return of picked-up items
text:
Can I return or exchange items I picked up in store?
A: Absolutely. Just bring the item and your receipt to any of our store locations. Our standard return policy applies.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Refers to a 'standard return policy' that is not stated in this document; the return window and conditions cannot be determined from this text.

title: Cancellation before pickup
text: You can cancel your order any time before it's been picked up.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Automatic cancellation and refund after 5 days unpicked
text: Or if you don’t pick it up after 5 days, we’ll automatically cancel and refund your purchase.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Store hold period
text: We’ll hold your order for 5 days. If it’s not picked up by then, it will be canceled and refunded.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Out-of-stock cancellation
text: In the event that an item becomes unavailable, we will cancel your order and notify you promptly.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: 'Promptly' is not defined; no specific notification timeframe is given.

title: No pickup location change after order
text: Unfortunately, once an order is placed, the pickup location can’t be changed. You’ll need to cancel and reorder.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Rewards card redemption restriction for certain brands
text: Rewards card cannot be redeemed for Festool or other brands that prohibit the use of free or discounted gift cards.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Pictorial and typographical errors correction
text: Pictorial and typographical errors are subject to correction when orders are placed.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees

title: Right to limit quantities
text: Rockler Woodworking and Hardware reserves the right to limit quantities.
source_title: Rockler FAQ: ordering, shipping, returns, guarantees
ambiguity_note: Discretionary right with no stated criteria.

title: Manufacturer-shipped items warranty and costs
text: Merchandise purchased and shipped directly from the manufacturer is covered by the manufacturer’s warranty and supersede any offer from Rockler. All items require authorization before returning.
source_title: Rockler return policy

title: Store return refund and shipping not refunded
text: Merchandise that is returned to a Rockler store location will receive a refund in the order of original payment. Original shipping charges will not be refunded.
source_title: Rockler return policy

title: Items with ground transportation restriction
text: Items marked "Shipping Restrictions: Ground Transportation Only" cannot ship to a PO Box and only can be shipped within the 48 contiguous states.
source_title: Rockler return policy

title: Back order of out-of-stock items
text: In the case of an out-of-stock, we will place the rest of your order, and put the out-of-stock item on back order. We will then notify you of the item on back order, and the date it is expected in. It will be automatically sent to you when it is back in stock.
source_title: Rockler return policy

title: Pickup ready time
text: Typically, orders are ready in about an hour during standard operating hours.
source_title: Rockler return policy
ambiguity_note: Typical timing only; not a guarantee.

title: Store pickup: only billing account holder may pick up
text: Only the person on the account’s billing information is authorized to pick up the order. They’ll need to bring a photo ID and confirmation email.
source_title: Rockler return policy

title: Return or exchange of store-picked-up items
text: Absolutely. Just bring the item and your receipt to any of our store locations. Our standard return policy applies.
source_title: Rockler return policy
ambiguity_note: Refers to a 'standard return policy' not included in this chunk; the return window and conditions are not stated here.
